items.source: By contrast, when handshake negotiation fails, the response status code will be 200 and the response headers and body will have been updated to reflect the cause for the failure. A HandshakeHandler implementation will have protected methods to customize updates to the response in those cases.
items.translation: 相比之下，当握手协商失败时，响应状态码将为 200，且响应头和正文将更新以反映失败原因。`HandshakeHandler` 的实现类将提供受保护的方法来定制这些情况下的响应更新。
